summary.text: House Democrats marked the reported death of Dolly Parton on August 25, the single day this dossier covers. Three members posted once each — @RepJoshG, @RepJulieJohnson and @RepKamlagerDove — so there is no leader and no day-to-day trajectory to trace. The framing is uniform personal tribute, anchored in "Dolly Parton" and "country music," with @RepJoshG calling her "an American legend" and recalling her rise from a one-room cabin in the Smokies. With one day and three posts, no shift in framing is observable and the evidence is too thin to generalize. Open questions: the entry remains provisional; whether volume grows; and whether members move from tribute to her legacy work.
